facts.did: 作为 Rational People 出身的产物：来自一个 mating cluster，众人同意混合遗传物质、打包成数百个几丁质孢子并从结果臂尖释放
facts.anchor: package it up in hundreds of chitinous spores

facts.did: 其孢子被一艘路过的堆肥船扫入口中，最早记忆是腐烂有机物温热的臭气（味道丰富多样）
facts.anchor: had been swept into the maw of a passing compost ship

facts.did: 一位来自杂色星群的长老，给 Gardenpath 取名 Wanderer 并帮其脱离 sprouthood（在其膜中植入感光器、曝露于星光以促生长）
facts.anchor: gave Gardenpath the name Wanderer and helped them emerge

facts.did: 在 Spigot 的星系盘发现一颗行星，其化学特征暗示生物呼吸（生命）；教授鼓励其申请研究生院主攻生态系统演化
最终硬化成石（sclerotic）、意识静止；在意识最后流失时怀疑理性只是幻觉、自己或是注定孤独死去的怪物
facts.anchor: Finally they became sclerotic, body hardening into stone

facts.did: 在名为 Crook-in-the-Road 的 cohousing 结构的医院中温暖潮湿中醒来（该地是记忆中的 Rational 场所）
facts.anchor: the cohousing structure known as Crook-in-the-Road

facts.did: 做了最后的善举：把 Gardenpath 僵直的身体藏在一艘异星船只的采集罐里
facts.anchor: in the collection tank of an alien vessel

facts.did: 注意到一个规律：这些书的许多作者都在 Memory 工作，而带回自己的探针正是 Memory 发射的
facts.anchor: Many of the authors of these books worked at the Memory.

relations.relation: Robust 是船上的长老，取自杂色星群，给其取名并帮其度过 sprouthood
relations.anchor: an elder named Robust from a motley assemblage of stars

relations.relation: Robust 对其做了最后的善举：藏起其僵直的身体
relations.anchor: done them a final kindness, stashing their inert body

relations.relation: 带回 Gardenpath 的探针出自同一处（Memory）
relations.anchor: place that had launched the probe that brought them home

relations.relation: 教授们鼓励 Gardenpath 申请研究生院
relations.anchor: encouraged Gardenpath to apply to graduate school

relations.relation: Gardenpath 现在有了一个最好的朋友和一个自己真正相信的项目
relations.anchor: had a best friend, and a project they truly believed in

numbers.fact: 孢子以数百个几丁质孢子的形式被释放
numbers.anchor: up in hundreds of chitinous spores, and release

numbers.fact: Crook-in-the-Road 是一万多 Rational People 的居住枢纽（多为农民和水矿工）
numbers.anchor: a residential hub for over ten thousand Rational People

numbers.fact: 其孢子可能经虫洞加速，最终落在与 Globe 起点几乎相反的位置
numbers.anchor: nearly 180 degrees from where it had started in the Globe
